newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-IOANNOU, 12, HELPS CYPRUS TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-IOANNOU, 12, HELPS CYPRUS TO VICTORY.

text.p: Twelve-year-old Maria Ioannou helped Cyprus beat Mexico 5-0 in the Sudirman Cup world team badminton championship on Thursday.
Ioannou, youngest player in the event, won her mixed doubles tie as Cyprus finished top of their group.
"I was very nervous when I arrived, but now I feel great," said the youngster. "Now I can just concentrate on winning."
Ioannou, who took up badminton aged six, regards former world champion Susi Susanti of Indonesia as her favourite player.
"I've only seen her from a distance so far, but I'm definitely going to watch her play her matches," said Ioannou.
As a special treat, organisers are set to arrange an introduction.
